title: Fix marketing logo asset reliability and unify header/footer logo source

requirements.summary: Ensure the marketing logo renders reliably in deployed builds for both header and footer, with no initial-load missing asset requests.
acceptanceCriteria: When loading the deployed app, the logo image is visible in the header area (left side) without requiring a refresh.
The footer logo image is visible and matches the header logo.
The browser DevTools Network tab shows no 404/failed request for the logo image asset(s) under /assets/generated/ on initial page load.

file_operations.description: Update the exported LOGO_SRC to resolve reliably in deployed builds (e.g., use the app base path via import.meta.env.BASE_URL when constructing the URL) while keeping it as the single source of truth for the marketing logo asset path.

Stop referencing the old hardcoded logo asset and instead render the logo using the shared LOGO_SRC/LOGO_ALT; keep/confirm graceful fallback behavior remains visible when the image fails to load (brand text remains, layout stable).
Add graceful image-load failure handling consistent with the header (e.g., hide broken image and keep brand text visible) while continuing to use the shared logo source of truth.
Ensure the referenced logo asset is present in shipped static assets at this exact path so deployed builds do not produce a missing asset request for the logo.

requirements.summary: Make header and footer share a single exported logo src/alt constant and ensure the referenced asset exists, with graceful fallback if missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Header.tsx does not hardcode a different logo path than the shared exported logo constant used elsewhere.
Both header and footer reference the same LOGO_SRC/LOGO_ALT values.
If the logo file is missing or fails to load, a graceful fallback remains visible (e.g., the brand name text still displays and layout does not collapse).

file_operations.description: Keep LOGO_SRC and LOGO_ALT as the single shared exported constants used by all marketing components; ensure the src value corresponds to a real file shipped in frontend static assets.
Import and use LOGO_SRC and LOGO_ALT from the shared marketing logo module; remove any hardcoded logo path/alt so header and footer remain consistent.
Confirm footer uses the shared LOGO_SRC/LOGO_ALT and implement/align fallback behavior so brand text stays visible and layout does not collapse if the image fails.
